name: @veren/device-id
description: Use when any component needs a stable per-machine identifier: it resolves a device ID once per process and keeps it stable across restarts and app reinstalls via an anchored store file plus a registry mirror, and best-effort across OS reinstalls via a hardware fingerprint match (SMBIOS UUID / board / disk serial / MachineGuid); skip it when a per-install random UUID is enough.
